tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Find and rank local shops in Chennai for a customer request. Always provide locality when the customer has told you where they are. If the customer has not said where they are, ask them for a Chennai area before calling this tool. Use category when it is clear. Results already satisfy distance, budg

tools.name: get_shop_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed public shop profile including address, locality, coordinates, weekly opening hours, upcoming closures, contact numbers, action mode, and latest menu timestamp.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Retrieve available menu or service catalog items for a shop grouped by category, with price display and duration, supporting cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search items within a specific shop catalog using text similarity and full-text search with optional price ceiling and item kind filtering.

tools.name: get_action_link
tools.description: Generate an actionable WhatsApp deep link, booking URL, or phone dial link with standard customer enquiry message for a shop and optional item.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_shops" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find and rank local shops in Chennai for a customer request. Always provide locality when the customer has told you where they are. If the customer has not said…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
